analysis: Pulmonary fibrosis is a known complication associated with the use of Methotrexate, particularly in patients receiving long-term therapy for conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis or certain cancers. While other drugs listed can have various pulmonary side effects, Methotrexate is most commonly linked to pulmonary fibrosis.
